Exposure management company Astelia Inc. today announced the launch of autonomous network mitigation, a new capability that allows organizations to block artificial intelligence-driven exploits at the network level, even when a patch isn’t available or can’t be applied. The new capability has been designed to address what Astelia says is the problem of frontier AI […]
